name: Force5
description: The design system behind wingfoil.ie's Force5 forecast map: a glass-on-sea surface language over one teal ramp and one canonical wind scale.

rules: ref.* is the raw scale. It names a value and nothing about where it is used.
sem.* is meaning. It aliases ref.* and never holds a literal value.
Component CSS consumes --sem-* only. --ref-* in a component is a lint failure.
Numeric steps run light to dark for colour (50 lightest, 950 darkest) and small to large for dimension.
Wind steps are named for the knot value they anchor: ref.color.wind.k35 is the colour at 35 knots.

provenance.method: Harvested every colour, radius, type size, weight, spacing and shadow literal from the UI sources; clustered the 70 opaque and 49 alpha colour literals by OKLab lightness at their shared hue; anchored the resulting ramp on the values that carried meaning (--ink #173d49, the action teal #245f6b, the sea #83afb9, the glass #edf5f3).
